article.body: October 16, 2026 Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with Gardner Bancshares, Inc. and Small Business Bank For release at 11:00 a.m. EDT Share The Federal Reserve Board on Friday announced the termination of the enforcement actions listed below: Gardner Bancshares, Inc., Lenexa, Kansas and Small Business Bank, Lenexa, Kansas Cease and Desist Order dated September 1, 2023 (PDF) Terminated October 13, 2026 Small Business Bank, Lenexa, Kansas Cease and Desist Order dated November 13, 2024 (PDF) Terminated October 13, 2026 Small Business Bank, Lenexa, Kansas Prompt Corrective Action dated June 29, 2026 (PDF) Terminated October 13, 2026 Additional enforcement actions can be searched for here . For media inquiries, please email [email protected] or call 202-452-2955.
article.title: Federal Reserve Board announces termination of enforcement actions with Gardner Bancshares, Inc. and Small Business Bank
